title: MoreLINQ
description: Extend LINQ with additional operators for grouping, batching, paging, and more.

data.text: `MoreLINQ` is a library that extends LINQ with operators not found in the standard library. It provides batch processing, paging, distinct by key, zip longest, maxBy, and many other useful methods.
MoreLINQ adds methods like `Batch`, `DistinctBy`, `MaxBy`, `Page`, and `ZipLongest` as extension methods on `IEnumerable<T>`.

data.title: Tip
data.text: MoreLINQ methods are lazily evaluated, so they compose efficiently with other LINQ operators like Where and Select.

MoreLINQ adds the operators that are missing from the standard library: `DistinctBy`, `MaxBy`, `Batch`, `Window`, `Partition`, and `Chunk` on older frameworks. Each replaces a loop you would otherwise hand-write, and most are lazy, so they compose with the rest of LINQ.

data.title: Common MoreLINQ operators
Prefer the built-in when it exists
data.text: Modern .NET added `DistinctBy`, `Chunk`, `MaxBy`, and `MinBy` to the standard library, so reach for those first and MoreLINQ for the rest — `Batch`, `Window`, `Partition`, `OrderBy` stability helpers. Being current on what the framework now provides is a small but telling signal in an interview.
